html_bullets.point: Hero MotoCorp management reported a gain of 600 basis points in market share within the entry-level segment for Q4, indicating strong competitive positioning.
Hero MotoCorp shares rallied nearly 4%, supported by the anticipated early monsoon, which is expected to boost farm incomes and discretionary rural spending on motorcycles.
Hero MotoCorp expects to outpace the two-wheeler industry growth, driven by a strong marriage season, favorable monsoon forecasts, and tax relief for consumers.
Hero MotoCorp reported a 6% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 1,081 crore for Q4 FY25, with revenue from operations growing 4.4% to Rs 9,938.65 crore.
Hero MotoCorp achieved its highest-ever revenue of Rs 40,756 crore and PAT of Rs 4,610 crore for FY25, driven by strong demand for premium motorcycles and a 44% surge in exports.
Hero MotoCorp reported a consolidated net profit increase of 24.21% to Rs 1,161.33 crore for the March 2025 quarter, compared to Rs 935.01 crore in the same quarter the previous year.
Hero MotoCorp declared a final dividend of Rs 65 per share, totaling Rs 165 per share for FY25, reflecting a payout of 8,250%.
Hero MotoCorp's standalone net profit rose 6.39% to Rs 1,080.94 crore, with revenue growth of 4.41% to Rs 9,938.65 crore in Q4 FY25.
Hero MotoCorp's electric vehicle business is expected to break-even in two years, signaling a strong focus on EV growth.
Hero MotoCorp achieved its highest-ever EV sales, marking a nearly 200% increase over FY24, driven by the success of Vida scooters.
Hero MotoCorp completed a strategic investment of Rs 510 crore in Euler Motors, acquiring 34.10% of the company, making it an associate company.
Hero MotoCorp announced the cancellation of its Investor Day scheduled for May 19, 2025, raising concerns about transparency and investor communication.
Analysts express caution regarding Hero MotoCorp's growth prospects in FY26 due to competition and challenges in the premium ICE bike segment.
Hero MotoCorp's earnings are expected to remain stable; however, slowing sales are anticipated to impact revenue.
Hero MotoCorp is expected to report muted Q4 earnings, potentially marking the weakest performance among two-wheeler manufacturers.
Hero MotoCorp scheduled an earnings conference call with analysts and investors on May 14, 2025, following the Board of Directors meeting on May 13, 2025.
Hero MotoCorp's Board of Directors approved a final dividend of 3,250%, amounting to Rs 65 per share, subject to member approval at the upcoming AGM.
